title: Fried Egg and Pepper Buns with Goat Cheese
blurb: Toasted buns filled with fried eggs, sweet peppers and melted goat cheese
steps: Heat half the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and add the pepper strips.
Cook the peppers for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly charred at the edges.
Meanwhile, split the buns and toast them cut-side down in a dry pan or under the grill until golden.
Push the peppers to the sides of the pan, add the remaining oil to the centre and crack in the eggs.
Fry the eggs for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks remain runny.
Place a fried egg on the bottom half of each bun, top with the peppers and slices of goat cheese.
Season with black pepper, close with the bun tops and serve immediately.
